thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT P1] dedicated-pool: nodepool-memory-fragmentation high (alert: GPU_VRAM_FRAGMENTATION_HIGH). trigger: fragmentation_ratio > 0.3 for 5m on pool=dedicated-inference-pool. paging @oncall. link: https://ops.example.com/alert/GPV-2026-1122

arjun: ack. seeing spike correlating with multiple model reloads from canary deploys. Pods getting OOMKilled on 3 different nodes.

vivian: stack: 
- affected nodes: gpu-node-21, gpu-node-23, gpu-node-27
- symptom: gpu memory fragmentation percent jumps 0.05 -> 0.38 after model swap, memory_used_ratio stays ~0.78 -> 0.9 on heavy load
- recent change: canary deployment of embedding-worker:v2 (rolling) started ~1805550600

nate: can you paste the OOM logs?

vivian: logs: 
```
kubelet: Evicted container "embedding-worker" memory limit exceeded: RSS used: 12.4G, limit: 12G
nvidia: gpu memory allocation failed: out of memory
application: model loader failed to allocate tensor of shape [1,2050] size 512MB
```

arjun: immediate mitigation: pause the canary rollout and cordon one of the highly fragmented nodes (gpu-node-23) to prevent further scheduling. I'll bump the pod memory request on embedding-worker to 13G temporarily.

infra-bot: Cordoned gpu-node-23. Migration: scale up fallback pool and move 4 pods.

ops-bot: Canary rollout paused via rollout pause deployment/embedding-worker.

nate: quick analysis: fragmentation metric we've been collecting (nvidia_gpu_memory_fragmentation_ratio) is noisy during model swaps and GC. Current alert rule is panic: fragmentation > 0.2 for 1m -> page. That's too aggressive. We should change to require fragmentation > 0.30 AND memory_used_ratio > 0.85 for 10m to reduce false positives.

arjun: agree. also add a cooldown so the same pool doesn't page twice within 30m.

vivian: proposed PromQL for new rule: 
```promql
# high fragmentation + high utilization sustained
avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_memory_fragmentation_ratio{pool="dedicated-inference-pool"}[10m]) > 0.30
and
avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_memory_used_ratio{pool="dedicated-inference-pool"}[10m]) > 0.85
```

nate: and a cluster-level rule to detect cross-node correlated fragmentation spikes (possible shared driver/allocator bug): 
```promql
sum by (cluster) (increase(nvidia_gpu_memory_fragmentation_events_total[15m])) > 5
```

arjun: for alertmanager, add a runbook link and an automated mute option when ops-runbook is claimed: 
```yaml
- matchers:
  - name: alertname
    value: "GPU_VRAM_FRAGMENTATION_HIGH"
  duration: 20m
  createdBy: oncall
  comment: "Auto-silence while investigating fragmentation in dedicated pool"
```

vivian: root cause hypothesis: model hot-reloads + current allocator fallback cause fragmentation; some versions of the CUDA allocator don't compact freed blocks efficiently. Workarounds: pre-allocate arena, use single model instance per pod, or bump memory headroom.

arjun: mitigation plan: 
1) pause canary (done)
2) increase requests for embedding-worker to 13G (temporary) & restart replicas one-by-one
3) deploy new DaemonSet that runs a nightly vram-defrag job on each node (collector+soft-restart of drivers) — low-risk attempt
4) change alerts as proposed and add 7-day noise report

nate: will open infra PR for prometheus rules + alertmanager silence + grafana panels. Add a heatmap that shows per-gpu fragmentation over time and a correlating panel for model deployment events.

arjun: customer impact: a few user requests stalled for ~6s and some retries observed. No persistent 5xxs. Marking as limited impact; we'll attach affected request ids to the ticket.

vivian: re: scheduling: temporarily set podAntiAffinity looser so we don't pack high-mem pods on same node until fragmentation stabilizes.

ops-bot: Pods rescheduled: 4 embedding-worker pods -> fallback pool. Eviction count: 3.

arjun: tracking items (INC-1805551234-FOLLOWUP): 
- update prometheus rule to new fragmentation+utilization logic
- add cluster-level fragmentation correlation rule
- PR for Grafana: per-gpu fragmentation heatmap + model-deploy annotation layer
- implement nightly defrag probe (pooled job), evaluate for 7 days
- run noise analysis and adjust cooldowns per pool
- document runbook steps for fragmentation incidents

nate: PR created: https://git.example.com/infra/alerts/pulls/487 (tags: fragmentation, urg)

vivian: uncordoning gpu-node-23 after bump and restart: 
```
kubectl uncordon gpu-node-23
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/nvidia-drivers -n kube-system
```

infra-bot: gpu-node-23 rejoined. No new OOMs observed in last 20m. fragmentation dropped to 0.12 on that node.

arjun: leaving a watch for 1hr, then handing off to next oncall. Nate/Vivian, please include me in PR reviews.

nate: will run a 7-day noise export and check alert false-positive rate. I'll include recommendations in the PR.

vivian: adding a note: consider exposing allocator metrics from the embedding runtime (arena_free_ratio) — would help correlate app-level fragmentation vs driver-level.

arjun: closing page as mitigated for now. Followups tracked in INC-1805551234-FOLLOWUP. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1122 status -> mitigated. duration: ~12m. Followups: INC-1805551234-FOLLOWUP.

nate: thanks team. I'll schedule a 30min post-incident sync to review thresholds and noise.

vivian: thanks all.
